messages.author: 7067b860f2b47ef8
messages.subject: Basic questions on posting summary data from object
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to use Shiny to output some basic calculations.

I want to display this plot and the random forest from the iris data set.

# iris.rf <- randomForest(Species ~ ., data=iris, importance=TRUE,
#                         proximity=TRUE)
# summary(iris.rf)
# 
# set.seed(17)
# iris.urf <- randomForest(iris[, -5])
# MDSplot(iris.urf, iris$Species)


However nothing I seem to do can get this to print out. I am sure I am overlooking something basic, but for instance the renderPlot doesn't work at all. And it seems like all the information needs to be local to the ui or else nothing runs.



ui=fluidPage(


headerPanel("Hello Shiny! This is an example of a random forest!"),

              renderPlot(MDSplot(iris.urf, iris$Species)),

renderText(iris.rf )


            )

server=function(input,output){
  
  

  
  
  }

Thanks,

Michael Lanier

parts: I suggest going through the tutorial. The renderPlot and renderText should go in the server function, and they need corresponding plotOutput and textOutput in the ui.
